visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with reddish hair, wearing a black beanie and a white graphic t-shirt, sits cross-legged on a row of airplane seats that have been converted into a flat bed. She smiles at the camera while adjusting her beanie with both hands. The cabin is dimly lit with purple ambient light. (2) The camera moves to show a close-up of the seats covered in a white mattress pad and pillows. The headrest monitors are visible. (3) An exterior shot shows the airport tarmac under a sunny, cloud-scattered sky. Several Air New Zealand planes with their signature black-and-white fern logos are parked. (4) A screen at the gate displays flight NZ78 to Auckland. (5) The woman is seen in a selfie-style shot with a male flight attendant in a suit; they both smile. (6) A montage shows various cabin features: a hand adjusting the seatbed, the woman lying down comfortably with a pillow, and a smartphone screen displaying Wi-Fi connection settings. (7) Close-ups of a seatback screen show a menu for snacks and drinks. A hand taps the screen. (8) Two glasses of red juice are toasted in a dark cabin. The woman is then seen eating from a food tray and sipping wine. (9) A screen interface shows a seat-to-seat chat function. (10) The woman holds up an amenity kit, pulling out a wooden toothbrush and a tube of cream. (11) Aerial footage shows a lush green landscape with a winding river followed by a shot of the woman wearing a green helmet on a mountain chairlift. (12) The video ends with a series of still photos of her with crew members and her sitting in the economy 'Skycouch'.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 只有搭過經濟艙的我. [Logo]: @1_shiuan. (2) [Slogan]: Air New Zealand, awarded the 'Safest Airline of 2025'. (3) [Subtitle]: 來體驗一下：平民版商務艙. (4) [Subtitle]: 第一次在飛機上躺著睡！真酷！. (5) [Subtitle]: 榮獲 2025 年「最安全航空」的紐西蘭航空. (6) [Subtitle]: 是台北唯一直飛紐西蘭. (7) [Subtitle]: 我只有搭過經濟艙. (8) [Subtitle]: 能夠在飛機上躺著睡，真的太讚了啦！. (9) [Subtitle]: 而且全程 Wi-Fi 無線上網. (10) [Subtitle]: 還有 mini bar 可以點零食，自選調酒. (11) [Subtitle]: 紐西蘭的白酒跟紅酒無限暢飲. (12) [Subtitle]: 螢幕上的機位還可以跟別人聊天. (13) [Subtitle]: 但我個人最喜歡的是過夜包，都是永續材質. (14) [Subtitle]: 只能說，如果你跟我一樣沒有機會搭商務艙. (15) [Subtitle]: 那我覺得你一定要體驗. (16) [Subtitle]: 紐西蘭航空的經濟艙「空中沙發 Skycouch」.

Faint airplane cabin hum provides a subtle ambient bed. (2) A sharp mechanical click occurs as the narrator describes the seat features. The music maintains a consistent, driving beat. The voice remains bright and friendly. (3) A brief male voice says 'Hello, Hello' with clear articulation and positive valence. The female narrator resumes quickly. (4) Digital UI 'blip' sounds are layered over the music as the screen is touched. The spectral brightness is high, emphasizing the modern production style. (5) The narration continues over the rhythmic BGM as food and drink service is mentioned. A subtle 'ding' notification sound signals a transition. (6) The video concludes with the music fading slightly, maintaining the energetic mood until the last frame.
